subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined words in the given sentence.**

Piyush is __inexperienced__ in leather industry.
solution: The correct answer is: "**A greenhorn**." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Inexperienced **means lacking experience or knowledge. (अनुभव या ज्ञान की कमी) • **Example**: *As an inexperienced driver, he was nervous about navigating through heavy traffic.* • "**A greenhorn**" is an idiom that means a person who is new to or inexperienced in a particular activity or field. (ऐसा व्यक्ति जो किसी विशेष गतिविधि या क्षेत्र में नया या अनुभवहीन हो) • **Example**: *Being a greenhorn in the corporate world, he sought guidance from more seasoned colleagues.* • The word "greenhorn" is often used in the context of someone who is new to a job or profession. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "**In great hands**" is an idiom that means to be in a safe or capable situation. (सुरक्षित या सक्षम स्थिति में होना) • "**A sore thumb**" is an idiom that means to stand out or be conspicuous in a negative way. (नकारात्मक तरीके से अलग दिखना या प्रमुख होना) • "**Hang fire**" is an idiom that means to delay or hold off on taking action. (कार्रवाई करने में देरी करना या रोकना) 42:T75f, The correct answer is: **EADCB**
